name: vllm-captioning-final-benchmark
description: A final image-captioning benchmark intended to evaluate multimodal models (via vLLM) on their ability to generate descriptive captions for images, assessing fluency, relevance, and alignment with reference captions. It compares generated captions to ground-truth references using standard captioning metrics.
reputation: Used within the vLLM community for internal captioning evaluation; has limited broader adoption.
